limitations: All data-shard runtime code is injected with hardhat_setCode, not deployed by transactions.
PoolManager, model, hook, router and test tokens are deployed by actual local transactions.
Conditional vocabulary tree evaluates one 13-node path per word; all 265 hidden units and both dense 265x265 matrices are evaluated.
This benchmark establishes EVM behavior and gas, not language quality or mainnet deployment readiness.
100-update local experiment, not a converged model or evidence of sentence quality.
Only local synthetic voice/composition corpora; vocabulary and tree coverage are partial.
Unused vocabulary rows and unvisited tree nodes remain randomly initialized.
No padding: every hidden dimension is a real input/output dimension of dense recurrence and classifiers.

training.initialization: independent random full-width tensors; no copied/padded weights
training.location: local CPU only; no hosted training
